en.title: Acne & Skin
en.who: Guests who mark breakouts, oily skin, breakouts before their period, marks left after pimples, or breakouts when stressed. Ask for Irene's skin guide sheet too.
studyWhy: all illness starts in the gut
know: A pore becomes a pimple when four things line up: too much oil, a plug, bacteria in the trapped oil, and inflammation. Skincare handles the last two.
The first two are set inside: sugar spikes raise insulin and IGF-1, which turn the oil up; a gut out of balance adds inflammation; stress and short sleep turn the oil up too.
Before the period, hormones shift and breakouts show up along the jaw and chin, right on schedule.
Marks are mostly pigment left after inflammation, not scars. Picking and sun make them darker.
Washing harder backfires. Stripped skin makes more oil, and dehydrated skin gets oilier, not drier.
manage: Clear: stop the sugar spike (don't quit rice, slow it down); fibre and probiotics for the gut; Liver Support for the load.
Regulate: a gentle cleanser; salicylic acid toner on the whole area, not just the spot; patch it, don't pick.
Replenish: protein (skin rebuilds with it), vitamin C, the B vitamins.
Sustain: SPF every day; sleep; skin renews about once a month, so judge it over two or three months.
Doctor first: deep painful lumps, scarring, acne with irregular periods or extra hair growth, or breakouts that affect their mood.
ask: When do you break out most?
What do you use on your skin now?
consult: After sugar or takeout
That's a sugar spike turning your oil up. You don't have to quit rice, you just stop the spike.
Before my period, on the jaw
It comes on schedule, so you can get ahead of it. Start before it shows, and don't pick, patch it.
Oily by noon and still breaking out
Washing harder makes it worse. Wash gentler and keep the skin hydrated.
Marks that won't fade
Those are pigment, not scars. Don't pick, and wear sunscreen every day so they don't get darker.
When I'm stressed
Your oil glands listen to stress. Sleep is the free half of this plan.
Dull, uneven skin
Skin rebuilds itself with protein, and vitamin C turns that protein into collagen. The glow comes from what you feed it every day.
en.demo: The vitamin C apple for marks and dull skin: plain slices brown, the vitamin C ones stay fresh. Have the toner and Spot On Dots in hand.

bundle.ask: From what you told me, I'd work on it from the inside and the outside together. This is where I'd start. Want to take it home tonight?

followup: Are you using the toner on the whole area, not just the spot?
Skin renews about once a month, so this is the first real check. What's changed?
quiz: What four things turn a pore into a pimple?
Too much oil, a plug, bacteria in the trapped oil, inflammation.
Which of them are set inside the body?
Oil (sugar spikes, insulin and IGF-1, stress and sleep) and inflammation (gut, liver load).
Why salicylic acid in the toner?
It dissolves in oil, so it gets inside the pore and breaks the plug up.
Why patch instead of pick?
Picking is the main cause of marks, and marks last months longer than the pimple.
Breakouts before the period: what helps, and how is it taken?
Cycle Support every day through the month, judged over about three cycles.
What stops marks from getting darker?
Not picking, sunscreen every day, and vitamin C.
Oily skin: wash more?
No. Stripped skin makes more oil. Wash gentler and hydrate.
Why is the liver in an acne plan?
In the teaching we follow, the liver and gut clear what the skin would otherwise show; the liver also clears used hormones.
The one line for breakouts after takeout?
You don't have to quit rice, you just stop the spike.
When do you send them to a doctor or dermatologist first?
Deep painful lumps, scarring, acne with irregular periods or extra hair growth, or breakouts affecting their mood.
en.doctor: Deep painful lumps, scarring, acne with irregular periods or extra hair growth, or breakouts affecting their mood? See a doctor or dermatologist first.

zh.title: 皮肤与痘痘
zh.who: 适合在问卷里勾了爆痘、出油、经期前冒痘、痘印、压力一大就冒痘的客人。也可以找Irene要她的皮肤指南。
know: 一个毛孔变成痘，要四件事凑齐：油太多、毛孔堵住、细菌在闷住的油里繁殖、发炎。护肤品管的是后两件。
前两件是身体里面决定的：血糖冲高会推高胰岛素和IGF-1，让皮脂腺出更多油；肠道失衡会加重炎症；压力大、睡得少，出油也会变多。
经期前激素变化，痘痘常长在下巴和下颌线一带，而且很准时。
痘印大多是发炎后留下的色素，不是疤。挤和晒，都会让它更深。
越洗越油。洗得太干净，皮肤会出更多油来补偿；缺水的皮肤也是越缺越油。
manage: 清：别让血糖冲高（不用戒米饭，让糖慢下来）；用纤维和益生菌照顾肠道；用护肝片减轻负担。
调：换温和的洁面；水杨酸爽肤水整片擦，不只点在痘上；冒出来就贴，别挤。
补：蛋白质（皮肤更新的原料）、维生素C、B族。
养：每天防晒；睡够；皮肤大约一个月更新一轮，按两三个月看效果。
先看医生：又深又痛的硬包、已经留疤、痘痘同时伴随月经不规律或毛发变多，或者痘痘让人情绪很低落。
ask: 一般什么时候最容易冒痘？
现在皮肤上都用些什么？
consult: 吃甜的、吃外卖就冒痘
这是血糖冲高，把出油量推上去了。不用戒米饭，只要别让它冲那么高。
经期前，下巴一圈冒痘
它很准时，所以你可以提前准备。在冒出来之前就开始，冒出来了也别挤，贴上。
中午就出油，还一直冒痘
越洗越油。洗得温和一点，把水补够。
痘好了，印子还在
那是色素，不是疤。别挤，每天防晒，印子才不会越来越深。
压力一大就爆痘
皮脂腺会听压力的指挥。睡眠是这套方案里免费的那一半。
气色差、肤色不均
皮肤靠蛋白质更新，维C把蛋白质变成胶原蛋白。好气色来自你每天喂给皮肤的东西。
zh.demo: 维C苹果演示，针对痘印和暗沉：没涂的苹果片变黄，涂了维C的还是新鲜的。手边备好控痘爽肤水和痘痘贴。

core: 内调：护肝片 + 益生元纤维粉
外护：雅姿玫瑰控痘爽肤水 + 雅姿痘痘贴
addons: 吃甜的、外卖后冒痘：阻碳片
经期前冒痘：女性周期支持（整个月都吃；怀孕、备孕或服用激素避孕药的先问医生）
痘印：维生素C缓释片、雅姿维C精华、雅姿SPF50防晒
出油多：雅姿保湿慕斯洁面
bundle.ask: 按你说的情况，我建议里外一起调：这几样是我会先从这里开始的。今天要不要先带回去？

followup: 爽肤水是整片擦，还是只点在痘上？
皮肤大约一个月更新一轮，现在是第一次真正看效果的时候。有什么变化？
quiz: 毛孔变成痘，需要哪四件事凑齐？
油太多、毛孔堵住、细菌在闷住的油里繁殖、发炎。
其中哪些是身体里面决定的？
出油（血糖冲高、胰岛素和IGF-1、压力和睡眠）和炎症（肠道、肝的负担）。
爽肤水为什么用水杨酸？
它溶于油，能钻进毛孔把堵塞化开。
为什么要贴不要挤？
挤是留痘印的主要原因，痘印比痘本身多留好几个月。
经期前冒痘，用什么、怎么吃？
女性周期支持，整个月每天吃，大约三个周期看效果。
怎样不让痘印变深？
不挤、每天防晒、补维C。
出油多，要不要多洗几次？
不要。洗太干净反而出更多油，要洗得温和、补够水。
为什么痘痘方案里有护肝？
按我们的调理思路，肝和肠道负责清理，不然就会表现在皮肤上；肝也负责清除用过的激素。
吃外卖后冒痘，那一句怎么说？
不用戒米饭，只要别让血糖冲那么高。
什么情况先让客人去看医生或皮肤科？
又深又痛的硬包、已经留疤、痘痘伴随月经不规律或毛发变多，或者痘痘影响情绪。
zh.doctor: 如果是又深又痛的硬包、已经留疤、痘痘同时伴随月经不规律或毛发变多，或者痘痘让你情绪很低落，请先去看医生或皮肤科。
